rule: all zero components must live in the same parent/source-profile branch
meaning: prevents mixing private EM zero with unrelated boundary assumptions

rule: each residual component is either zero-certified, numerically bounded, or explicitly missing
meaning: no silent closure of the residual radius

rule: a partial zero certificate does not unlock rho_H/M_lower
meaning: profile integral plus missing residual components still blocks

rule: fixed EM/Poynting and private kappa drift can zero their own components only inside their signed branch
meaning: keeps useful partial progress without overclaiming

rule: post-fit residual cancellation cannot be used as a zero certificate
